Former Minister of State for the Federal Capital Territory, Jumoke Akinjide, has declared support for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid and the governorship ambition of Sharafadeen Alli in Oyo State. The development signalled her return to active political mobilisation ahead of the 2027 elections. Akinjide, a former member of the Federal Executive Council with longstanding political connections in Oyo State, declared her support for both politicians under the banner of the Renewed Hope Agenda, urging her supporters to unite behind their ambitions. The declaration was announced by her Special Assistant, Olatundun Gabriel, who unveiled the slogan, ‘JUMOKE IS COMING — RENEWED HOPE 2027’, in a statement obtained by The PUNCH on Sunday. Gabriel described the declaration as the beginning of a fresh political engagement, calling on Akinjide’s supporters across the state and beyond to prepare for renewed mobilisation. The statement thanked Akinjide’s political associates for their continued loyalty and support, adding that further directives and political engagements would be announced. Her declaration comes as political parties and prominent figures in Oyo State begin positioning ahead of the 2027 governorship election, in which the APC is expected to challenge the incumbent political establishment for control of the state.
